reconstruction.heightBasis: No current or retained numeric heights or level counts are available. Picture-led visualization estimates above working floor: podium 1 m; west wing eaves 8 m; main hall eaves 10.8 m; main flat roof 11.2 m and parapet 12.6 m. Main dome drum 11.2–13 m, pale pointed cap to 21.4 m and finial 23 m; side dome base 8.2 m, cap to 12.2 m and finial 13.5 m. Twin minarets have square bases to 12 m, tapered octagonal shafts to 25 m, projecting balcony around 25–26.3 m, upper tiers to 34 m, smaller balcony and pale pointed cap/finial to 42 m. Every vertical dimension, window rhythm, parapet module, tier, balcony and dome profile is approximate. No engineering or furnished interior claim.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi Masjid al-Qiblatain exterior: exact irregular main footprint, pale main dome and smaller western side dome, paired stepped square/octagonal minarets with projecting balconies and pointed caps, light roof cornices, open original diamond parapets and recessed pointed entrance/window rhythms. Internal plan, roof/tower centers and all heights are explicit picture estimates. Five existing shared 256² graphs serve six merged roles and four separate budgeted browser LODs. Newer surrounding decks, shade canopies, parking, garden, city, fine historic screen artwork and furnished interiors omitted.
